businesses.business: Regenerative tissue products for wound care

offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures regenerative tissue products for treating chronic wounds, including diabetic foot ulcers and venous leg ulcers. Sells them to hospitals, wound care centers and physicians, who apply them to patients.

primary_products.value: bilayered living cell skin substitutes; dermal wound matrices; collagen wound dressings

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, wound care centers, physician practices, ambulatory surgery centers

revenue_model.value: product sales: wound care products sold to hospitals, clinics and physicians; healthcare reimbursement: payer reimbursement for skin substitutes applied to patients

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures tissue-based wound products, sold to hospitals and physicians

geography_served.value: US national: United States, with sales across most states

specialization.value: related lines: skin substitutes, dermal matrices and collagen dressings sharing wound care customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: own sales force calling on hospitals and wound care clinics; distributors / dealers: third-party distributors for some products

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA device and biologics approval for tissue products, Medicare coverage rules for skin substitutes
